notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year! We're giving away 10 CDKs of DWO
notes.notes:
Dear fellow gamers,
Sunny Games wishes everyone:
[i]May the auspicious serpent dance in the spring breeze,
And blessings fill your embrace with ease.
Peaceful years enduring long,
Harmony guiding all things along.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865237/8abb2e9f86904e41236f7ce361f407e9ae259517.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865237/8488e74754a8dd4df0b08227297ec7136b54232d.png[/img]

To celebrate the Lunar New Year, we've prepared special giveaway events!

🎁 1st Giveaway on January 28th (New Year's Eve):
We'll randomly select 1 winner from the comments section of our latest Bilibili video "Dare to Buy? We Dare to Gift!" to receive a Dynasty Warriors: Origins CDK.

🎁 Up to 8 Giveaways from January 28th to February 4th:
Participate in our Xiaohongshu (Little Black Box) event where we'll give away up to 8 copies of Dynasty Warriors: Origins CDKs.

🎁 Final Giveaway on February 4th:
We'll select 1 final winner from our official QQ group (572602109) for Three Kingdoms Punk to receive the last Dynasty Warriors: Origins CDK.

In total, we're giving away 10 copies of Dynasty Warriors: Origins!
May everyone experience the charm of exceptional games, enjoy playing, and share the joy!

Best regards,
Sunny Games Team.

notes.title: 《T.K. Punk》coming! X《Fantasy of Caocao:2》DLC- free updates
notes.notes:
[b]Dear players! Happy Lunar New Year![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865237/65ab895218bf9c793ad35c9fd901bce228eebad9.jpg[/img]

Sonny Games' latest masterpiece, the cyber strategy RPG "Three Kingdoms Punk," has now unveiled its store page and released its first concept PV. Welcome to add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2505590

At the same time --
The DLC - Skin Pack for "Fantasy Cao Cao Legend 2" has been updated for free today with "Three Kingdoms Punk" series companion skins. Users who have purchased the skin can obtain the new skins for the four companions "Zuo Ci," "Zhang Starcolor," "Guan Yinping," and "Lü Lingqi" for free via the [Update⬇] button in their library. Open the game and check it out!

Additionally, "Fantasy Cao Cao Legend 2" is participating in the 2024 "Lunar New Year Sale" event --
During the Spring Festival period from February 7th to 16th, purchase the game base to enjoy a new historical low discount of -30%, and the "DLC - Skin Pack" is even offering an unprecedented new low discount of 25%. Collect it with the base game for only an additional +8.1 yuan to get on board.
